educational.title: Expense Reimbursement System
description: An expense management application with an Angular frontend and Spring Boot backend connected to PostgreSQL for relational data storage. The application integrates with Python services using OpenCV to process uploaded expense receipts, extract expense totals, and prepare the data for approval. The original receipt is converted into a PDF containing the original receipt followed by a page displaying the extracted expense information for storage and future reference.

educational.title: ZipCart Prototype
description: ZipCart is a self-checkout shopping application that allows users to scan items while shopping, verify their cart, and complete purchases while maintaining transaction records for future reference.

The application uses Ionic and Capacitor to deploy a shared codebase across web and Android platforms, with MySQL storing shopping and transaction data. A Spring Boot backend integrates with a Raspberry Pi to capture the weight of loose items, while a machine learning image-recognition model identifies fruits and vegetables. Users can weigh loose items, add them to their cart, and complete their shopping session. At checkout, the application generates a barcode that can be scanned by an API-based barcode scanner to verify the cart contents.

educational.title: CI/CD Pipeline
description: A project demonstrating the implementation of a Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) pipeline for the ZipCart prototype. The project automates the software build, testing, and deployment workflow to improve development efficiency and ensure consistent application delivery.

co-op.title: Punch-n-Spell
description: An interactive 2D educational game built with Vanilla JavaScript and HTML5 Canvas. The game renders and animates interactive elements while helping users learn Sanskrit vowels, consonants, and numbers through engaging gameplay.

co-op.title: Word Complex/WordHunt
description: An interactive web application built with React and ZIM.js featuring four educational games that use tokenized passages to teach Sanskrit linguistics through engaging and interactive gameplay.

co-op.title: Dictionary Application
description: A Python-based REST API that collects Sanskrit passages from designated sources, processes and tokenizes the text, and stores linguistic data in MongoDB for consumption by the Word Complex application.
